briefing: Markets were mildly weaker today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash is $389.29, below the $500 threshold needed to responsibly size a new position, so per past lessons we held rather than forcing a buy — existing positions continue to run under their automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors turn cautious and avoid adding new exposure, even if the market decline is mild — often shown by simply holding cash rather than deploying it. Today's slight pullback combined with insufficient cash to size a new position responsibly made holding the right call rather than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避（Risk-Off）」是指投資者轉趨審慎，即使市場跌幅輕微，也傾向不增加新持倉，例如選擇持有現金而非強行進場。今日市場小幅走弱，加上現金水平不足以穩健建立新倉位，因此持有觀望才是正確做法，而非勉強交易。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, low-conviction trading, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500 slightly. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move, consistent with a market pausing to digest recent gains rather than reacting to fresh news. Without a clear risk-on trigger, this looks like routine consolidation rather than the start of a deeper pullback.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數均小幅回落，成交氣氛清淡，缺乏方向感，納斯達克表現略遜於標普500指數。市場並無單一明顯的催化因素，較像是消化近期升幅後的整固，而非受突發消息影響。在未見明確的風險偏好訊號下，這波回調傾向於例行性整理，而非深度回調的開端。
